data_fields.name: rule_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: Lua chance default 50 (1 in N per matching node per run)

data_fields.name: rule_y_band
data_fields.donor_constant: min_y default INT16_MIN, max_y default INT16_MAX

data_fields.name: phase_jitter
data_fields.donor_constant: random start within about +-0.51 x interval, clamped +-60 s, int-truncated

best_idea: Run spawn rules on a fixed server pass with per-rule timers, shuffled order, a density count handed to each rule, and a time budget that defers the rest of the zones to the next pass.
decision_why: Cadence, per-rule timer and time budget fit a per-tick NPC budget (row 18 sub-line) and zone population (row 23); the per-node 1-in-N roll would scale spawn density with anchor count, and the donor catch-up is a no-op, so both are rejected.
acceptance: A server test: a zone rule with interval 10 s runs at most once per 10 s of server time; with a 200 ms budget, a pass over N zones stops early and unvisited zones run on the next pass; the rule receives zone and neighbourhood counts so it can refuse a spawn over the cap.
